_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in an Anxiety coil with mixed internals (suppressed ETF flows vs soft F&G/funding); base rate favors HOLD until a breaker appears, with drift toward Complacency if the band holds.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: both on current Anxiety; only analyst gives explicit forward Complacency/HOLD — narrative has no forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed stays 42-54, 30d momentum soft, ETF flows still suppressed
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks under 39 with funding negative, or ETF flows and momentum surge together out of 47-54
